name: Gasthof Kirchenwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Kirchenwirt is situated in the picturesque community of Thiersee in Tyrol, Austria. The accommodation is located close to Lake Thiersee and the dramatic surrounding mountain panorama. Built in classic Tyrolean style, the inn welcomes guests with a tranquil, relaxed atmosphere. The guest rooms are simply appointed and provide everything needed for a carefree holiday. The surrounding landscape offers a wealth of activities such as hiking and skiing. Guests can enjoy authentic regional dining in the inn's restaurant. On-site parking and Wi-Fi access are also provided.
